name: Indicators of the Elysian Concord
summary: The Concord Account: measurement principles, the Unmeasured Register, and every published indicator, each derived from the dataset that owns it.

units.note: Each indicator carries its own unit field.

buildNote: Generated by tools/build_metrics.py, which reads the source datasets. No indicator value is typed by hand.

producer.name: The Statistical Service
producer.summary: A division of the Record Office with statutorily protected methodological independence, validated by the Audit Service. Not a sixth Independent Office — the Charter fixes those at five.

principles.name: No composite headline index
principles.summary: The Concord refuses to produce a single number for how it is doing. A single number invites optimisation and hides tradeoffs; the same reasoning as the Monetary Authority's unordered mandate — publish the tradeoff rather than resolve it silently.

principles.name: Distributions, not central values
principles.summary: Every indicator publishes its spread. A median without a distribution is treated as misleading rather than incomplete.

principles.name: Paired counterweights
principles.summary: Indicators liable to gaming are published alongside an indicator that would move the wrong way if the first were gamed — clearance rate beside wrongful conviction, custody rate beside overturned convictions, diagnosis beside over-diagnosis harm.

principles.name: No indicator attaches to an individual
principles.summary: Generalised from the rule that no teacher-level outcome data is published: a measure attached to a person becomes a target for that person.

principles.name: Revision transparency
principles.summary: Any restatement publishes the superseded series alongside the new one, permanently.

principles.name: Indicators are not targets by default
principles.summary: Adopting an indicator as a target requires an Assembly resolution and carries an automatic sunset.

unmeasuredRegister.name: The Unmeasured Register
unmeasuredRegister.summary: A published list of things the Concord believes matter and cannot measure, maintained on the same principle as the Negative Register: what is not known must be visible, or it will be mistaken for what is not there.
entries: whether Elysians are lonely in ways surveys do not reach
whether the Concord is becoming complacent
the value to a future generation of a building deliberately left unfinished
whether restraint is wisdom or fear
the quality of a Contention as opposed to its popularity
what is lost when a language with 400 speakers stops being spoken
whether the published record is read by anyone who would act on it
unmeasuredRegister.canonNote: The Register is short by design and every proposed addition is argued over. Its existence is the Concord's answer to its own comparability distortion: a league table that omits what cannot be counted at least admits the omission.

indicators.name: Median lifespan at birth
indicators.summary: Biological inheritance from helicin error correction, not a medical achievement.

indicators.name: Median healthy lifespan
indicators.summary: Risen from 71 EY at the founding; the gap to median lifespan is what Concord medicine actually closed.

indicators.name: Late-life cognitive decline prevalence
indicators.summary: The largest cause of disability in the Concord; no prevention and no reversal.

indicators.name: Suicide rate
indicators.summary: Flat for sixty years despite investment; the services call the plateau unexplained.

indicators.name: Education entitlement drawn, low earners
indicators.summary: A universal right used most by those already advantaged.

indicators.name: Reported life evaluation
indicators.summary: Plateaued four decades ago at a high level. The Statistical Service states plainly that it does not know why, and declines to treat the plateau as either success or failure.

indicators.name: Reported financial distress
indicators.summary: Fell by two-thirds on introduction of the Civic Income.

indicators.name: Wealth Gini
indicators.summary: Has not fallen in ninety years. The clearest unsolved distributional problem in the Concord.

indicators.name: Reoffending within 5 EY of release
indicators.summary: Against a published target of 12%, missed for forty years.

indicators.name: Deaths following police contact
indicators.summary: Counted, not averaged; each published with name, District, and circumstances.

indicators.name: Convictions later overturned
indicators.summary: Published as a floor on the true rate, not a measurement of it.

indicators.name: Atmospheric CO2
indicators.summary: Mid-corridor within the constitutional band of 320-360 ppm.

indicators.name: Net carbon position
indicators.summary: Slight net drawdown, holding position.

indicators.name: Ocean overturning strength
indicators.summary: Constitutional emergency triggers automatically at 80%.

indicators.name: Legacy persistent chemical burden
indicators.summary: Falling 0.9% a year; projected clearance in the EY 600s with no acceleration available.

indicators.name: Biodiversity Integrity Index
indicators.summary: Composite of species population trends, habitat connectivity, and functional group completeness, computed from planet.biosphere facts. Stable and not recovering.

indicators.name: Extinction debt
indicators.summary: 9,000-14,000 species committed by damage already done; recovery reaches perhaps a tenth. The strongest counter-argument to any account of the Concord as ecologically successful.

indicators.name: Replication rate of prominent findings
indicators.summary: The councils refuse to call the residual 29% acceptable.

indicators.name: Negative Register entries
indicators.summary: Consulted more often than the published literature by researchers designing new work.

indicators.name: Grid reserve margin
indicators.summary: Against a statutory minimum of 22%.

indicators.name: Communes failing the 14-day islanding drill
indicators.summary: Concentrated in the Regions least able to fix it.

indicators.name: Beryllium reserve horizon
indicators.summary: The hardest constraint in the Elysian energy system, with no current solution.

indicators.name: Food insecurity in the last year
indicators.summary: Concentrated among the severely unwell; a health failure appearing as a food statistic.

indicators.name: Secondary share of metal input
indicators.summary: Recovery rates have plateaued for forty years.

indicators.name: Trust in own District police service
Trust in Community Liaison
indicators.summary: The gap to the police service as a whole is stable and unexplained.

indicators.name: Believe corruption common at the Concord tier
indicators.summary: Perception exceeds measured reality and rises with distance from the resident.

indicators.name: Access refusals overturned on appeal
indicators.summary: Bodies with persistently high overturn rates are named.

indicators.name: Frailty-weighted dependency ratio
indicators.summary: Replaces old-age dependency, which is meaningless where health extends past 100 EY. Defined as the population-weighted sum of assessed frailty divided by the population without it.

atlasNote: This dataset drives the Atlas's overlay layers and information panels; each indicator carries the dataset it derives from so a panel can link back to its source.

knownWeaknesses.name: Comparability distortion persists
knownWeaknesses.summary: Published league tables reward measurable outcomes and can starve the unmeasurable; counterweights and the Unmeasured Register mitigate and do not solve it.

knownWeaknesses.name: Wellbeing rests on self-report
knownWeaknesses.summary: Life evaluation and financial distress are survey instruments, and the Statistical Service publishes its own methodological doubts alongside them.

knownWeaknesses.name: Pressure for a headline number
knownWeaknesses.summary: The refusal to publish a composite index is challenged roughly every decade by people who want the Concord to be able to say whether it is doing well.

knownWeaknesses.name: Several indicators have not moved in decades
knownWeaknesses.summary: Wealth Gini, suicide, reoffending, trust, and life evaluation are all flat, and the Concord has no agreed explanation for any of them.

knownWeaknesses.name: The Account is little read
knownWeaknesses.summary: The most complete published picture of the civilization is consulted by a small fraction of the population — the attention problem in its final form.
